faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What is TCF Canada and who needs it?
faq.a1: TCF Canada is a French test administered by France Éducation International and recognised by IRCC. It proves your language level for permanent residence (Express Entry, PNP) and citizenship.
faq.q2: How is the mock exam different from the real one?
faq.a2: The format, number of questions, timing and rules are the same: 39 questions, audio played once, no going back. The difference: you get your result instantly, with every question explained.
faq.q3: How do I subscribe? Is there online payment?
faq.a3: There is no online payment. You contact us, the administrator creates your account and adds coins. Then you activate the subscription yourself in your dashboard.
faq.a4: Coins are the platform’s internal credit (1 coin = 10 000 UZS). Use them for a time-based subscription or a single mock exam. Unused coins stay on your balance.
faq.q5: Does it work on a phone?
faq.a5: Yes, it works on phones, tablets and computers. Since the real exam is taken on a computer, we recommend taking full mock exams on a computer too.
faq.a6: Listening (CO) and reading (CE) are available now. Writing (EE) and speaking (EO) are coming soon.
